Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical data attribution error in its analysis of the second search result. While the WebSurfer correctly retrieved that H. Verlan Andersen died on July 16, 1992, the Planner incorrectly swapped the names and dates in its summary. It stated "Narc s Ventall : died 16 July 1992" and "H. Verlan Andersen: died 22 December 2018," effectively reversing the data collected for the two individuals. This misattribution led to the incorrect final conclusion that H. Verlan Andersen died later, when in reality, Narc s Ventall died later (2018 vs 1992).
